seed_rule: First 16 SHA256 bytes of UTF-8 str(20261124)+'|'+scenario_id, unsigned big-endian; PCG64
coupling: One PCG64 uniform array per scenario. Reuse each draw across the four distributions and three strengths, independent across parcels. Array columns follow route order, then parcel order in each input.
success: Actual release time of every late parcel is no greater than the departure time of its assigned replenishment flight in the user-supplied fixed schedule.
